answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ember of a task receipt, and the thread is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work.
